title: Netanyahu Rejects US-Led Gaza Peace Plan Amid Political Pressure
subtitle: The Israeli Prime Minister faces a difficult choice between international demands and domestic election needs.

summary.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially rejected a 15-point peace plan proposed by the United States. The roadmap intended to trade a full Israeli military withdrawal for the complete disarmament of Hamas. Despite the public rejection, the White House appears to view the move as part of Netanyahu's election campaign strategy. Military officials suggest that behind-the-scenes talks regarding the plan are still ongoing. The situation remains sensitive as Israel prepares for national elections in late October.
summary.zh: 以色列總理納坦雅胡已正式拒絕美國提出的十五點和平計畫。該路線圖旨在以以色列全面撤軍換取哈瑪斯完全解除武裝。儘管公開拒絕，白宮似乎將此舉視為納坦雅胡競選策略的一部分。軍方官員表示，關於該計畫的幕後談判仍在進行中。隨著以色列準備在十月下旬舉行大選，局勢依然敏感。

paragraphs.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially rejected a 15-point peace plan for Gaza proposed by United States President Donald Trump. During a cabinet meeting on Sunday, Netanyahu stated clearly that Israel would not accept the document. He insisted that the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) would not withdraw from the territory until Hamas is fully disarmed, covering all types of weaponry. This rejection marks a significant moment in the ongoing conflict, as it places the Israeli leader at odds with his most important international ally.
paragraphs.zh: 以色列總理納坦雅胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 已正式拒絕由美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 所提出的加薩十五點和平計畫。在週日的內閣會議中，納坦雅胡明確表示以色列不會接受這份文件。他堅持除非哈瑪斯 (Hamas) 完全解除武裝，涵蓋所有類型的武器，否則以色列國防軍 (IDF) 不會從該領土撤軍。這次拒絕是持續衝突中的重大時刻，因為這使得這位以色列領導人與他最重要的國際盟友產生了分歧。

paragraphs.en: The peace plan, developed by the US-led Board of Peace, aimed to end the war through a series of steps. Under the proposal, Hamas would give up its weapons to a new Palestinian administration. In exchange, Israeli forces would withdraw from the areas they currently control. An International Stabilization Force (ISF) would then work with a new Palestinian police force to keep the peace. While Hamas has expressed a willingness to follow the roadmap, provided that Israel meets its own obligations, Netanyahu’s government remains deeply skeptical of the group's intentions.
paragraphs.zh: 這項由美國主導的和平委員會所制定的和平計畫，旨在透過一系列步驟結束戰爭。根據該提案，哈瑪斯將向一個新的巴勒斯坦行政當局交出武器。作為交換，以色列軍隊將從目前控制的區域撤出。隨後，一支國際穩定部隊將與一支新的巴勒斯坦警察部隊合作以維持和平。儘管哈瑪斯表示願意遵循該路線圖，前提是以色列履行其自身義務，但納坦雅胡政府對該組織的意圖仍深表懷疑。

paragraphs.en: Despite the public disagreement, the White House has not reacted with immediate anger. According to BBC News, the US administration appears to be treating Netanyahu’s comments as campaign language ahead of Israel’s general election on October 27. A senior US official, quoted by Israeli journalist Barak Ravid, noted that the US understands Netanyahu’s domestic political needs. As long as Israel continues to follow specific requests—such as limiting military strikes in Gaza—the US seems willing to tolerate the Prime Minister’s public stance.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管存在公開分歧，白宮並未表現出立即的憤怒。根據英國廣播公司新聞 (BBC News) 報導，美國政府似乎將納坦雅胡的言論視為以色列十月二十七日大選前的競選語言。以色列記者拉維德 (Barak Ravid) 引述一位美國資深官員的話指出，美國理解納坦雅胡的國內政治需求。只要以色列持續遵循特定要求——例如限制在加薩的軍事打擊——美國似乎願意容忍總理的公開立場。

paragraphs.en: This balancing act is becoming increasingly difficult for Netanyahu. He is currently facing pressure from far-right members of his coalition government who strongly oppose any concessions to Hamas. Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich publicly supported the Prime Minister’s decision, stating that the military must not withdraw even a small distance until their goal of destroying Hamas is achieved. With the election just over two months away, analysts suggest that Netanyahu is trying to satisfy these domestic partners while still managing his relationship with the US.
paragraphs.zh: 這種平衡行為對納坦雅胡而言正變得越來越困難。他目前面臨來自聯合政府中極右翼成員的壓力，這些成員強烈反對對哈瑪斯做出任何讓步。財政部長斯莫特里赫 (Bezalel Smotrich) 公開支持總理的決定，聲稱在達成摧毀哈瑪斯的目標之前，軍隊絕不能撤退哪怕一小段距離。隨著選舉僅剩兩個多月，分析人士認為納坦雅胡正試圖在滿足國內夥伴的同時，繼續處理與美國的關係。

paragraphs.en: The rejection of the plan surprised many, including senior Israeli military commanders. According to The Guardian, these commanders had been involved in recent meetings with the Prime Minister to discuss the technical details of the plan. Reports from Israel’s Channel 12 television suggested that Netanyahu had previously given his personal consent to the plan, including the specific locations for a pilot withdrawal in southern Gaza. The sudden public change in direction left many in the defense establishment confused, as they had not been informed of the shift before it was announced.
paragraphs.zh: 這項計畫遭到拒絕令許多人感到驚訝，包括以色列的高階軍事指揮官。根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，這些指揮官曾參與總理近期的會議，討論該計畫的技術細節。以色列第十二頻道電視台的報導顯示，納坦雅胡先前曾親自同意該計畫，包括在加薩南部進行試點撤軍的具體地點。這種突然的公開轉向讓國防體系中的許多人感到困惑，因為在宣布之前，他們並未被告知這一轉變。

paragraphs.en: Despite the tension, there are signs that the two sides are still communicating. Nickolay Mladenov, a high representative for the Board of Peace, told Israel’s Channel 12 that discussions are continuing. He expressed hope for a positive outcome, describing the plan as the only way to prevent future tragedies like the October 7, 2023, attacks that triggered the current war. Furthermore, there have been recent changes in military policy that suggest Israel is listening to US concerns. For instance, Netanyahu has recently made it harder for the military to authorize airstrikes, requiring higher-level approval unless there is an immediate danger.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管局勢緊張，仍有跡象顯示雙方仍在溝通。和平委員會的高級代表姆拉德諾夫 (Nickolay Mladenov) 向以色列第十二頻道表示，討論仍在持續進行。他對結果表示樂觀，並形容該計畫是防止未來發生類似二零二三年十月七日引發當前戰爭之攻擊悲劇的唯一途徑。此外，近期軍事政策的變更顯示以色列正在傾聽美國的擔憂。例如，納坦雅胡近期提高了軍方授權空襲的難度，除非面臨立即危險，否則需要更高層級的批准。

paragraphs.en: The future of the peace process remains uncertain. While the Board of Peace continues to push for the deployment of the International Stabilization Force, the construction of the first base in Rafah is still scheduled for the end of this month. Whether this will actually happen depends on whether Israel and the US can find a way to align their goals. For now, Netanyahu continues to describe President Trump as a great friend, even while standing firm against the specific ideas proposed by his administration.
paragraphs.zh: 和平進程的未來仍充滿不確定性。雖然和平委員會持續推動部署國際穩定部隊，但在拉法 (Rafah) 建設第一個基地的計畫仍預定於本月底進行。這是否會真正發生，取決於以色列與美國能否找到協調目標的方法。目前，納坦雅胡在堅決反對其政府所提具體構想的同時，仍持續將川普描述為一位偉大的朋友。

paragraphs.en: As the election date approaches, the political environment in Israel will likely remain heated. The Prime Minister is currently polling behind some of his rivals, making every decision on the Gaza conflict a matter of political survival. For the people living in the region, the outcome of these high-level negotiations will determine whether the current pause in heavy fighting leads to a lasting peace or if the conflict will continue to escalate. For now, the world is watching to see if the current standoff is merely a temporary disagreement or a sign that the US-backed roadmap has reached a dead end.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著選舉日期臨近，以色列的政治環境可能會持續升溫。總理目前的民調落後於部分競爭對手，這使得關於加薩衝突的每一個決定都成為政治生存的問題。對於生活在該地區的人民而言，這些高層談判的結果將決定當前激戰的暫停是通往持久和平，還是衝突將繼續升級。目前，全世界都在觀察當前的僵局僅是暫時的分歧，還是美國支持的路線圖已走入死胡同的跡象。

keyTerms.definitionEn: In disagreement or conflict with someone.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 與某人意見不合、有衝突。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個常見的慣用語，容易被誤解為「奇怪的」。文中：this rejection marks a significant moment in the ongoing conflict, as it places the Israeli leader at odds with his most important international ally.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Words spoken primarily to gain support from voters rather than to express a genuine policy position.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 競選語言（指為了爭取選票而說的話，未必是真實政策）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 容易誤以為是「競選的語言」，但這裡指為了選舉目的而發表的言論。文中：the US administration appears to be treating Netanyahu’s comments as campaign language ahead of Israel’s general election on October 27.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Refusing to change one's opinion or decision despite pressure.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡的 stand 不是「站立」，而是指態度堅決。文中：For now, Netanyahu continues to describe President Trump as a great friend, even while standing firm against the specific ideas proposed by his administration.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation that has no chance of progress or success.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 死胡同、無路可走的情況。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是「死路」，這裡比喻談判或計畫陷入僵局。文中：For now, the world is watching to see if the current standoff is merely a temporary disagreement or a sign that the US-backed roadmap has reached a dead end.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the current requirement for the Israeli military to conduct airstrikes in Gaza?

options.A: They must consult with the International Stabilization Force before every strike.
options.B: They must obtain approval from the US-led Board of Peace.
options.C: They require higher-level authorization unless there is an immediate threat.
options.D: They are completely prohibited from conducting any airstrikes until the election concludes.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第六段，文中明確提到 Netanyahu 最近調整了軍事政策，使得軍方更難授權空襲，除非面臨立即性危險，否則必須獲得更高層級的批准。選項 A 與文中提到的國際穩定部隊（ISF）職責不符；選項 B 錯誤，因為決策權仍在以色列內部；選項 D 過於誇大，文中僅提到限制而非全面禁止。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about Netanyahu’s true stance on the peace plan based on the reports from Channel 12?

options.A: He was never interested in the plan and only pretended to support it to deceive Hamas.
options.B: He likely initially agreed to the plan but changed his public position due to domestic political pressure.
options.C: He strongly opposed the plan from the beginning but kept his feelings secret from his own military commanders.
options.D: He is secretly working with the US to ensure the plan fails before the election.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第五段，Channel 12 的報導指出 Netanyahu 曾給予該計畫個人同意，且軍事指揮官對他突然公開反對感到困惑。結合第四段提到他面臨極右翼聯盟成員的強大壓力，可以推論他最初可能支持該計畫，但為了選票與政治生存，被迫在公開場合轉向反對。選項 A、C、D 皆缺乏證據支持，且忽略了政治環境對其決策的影響。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does the phrase 'campaign language' imply about Netanyahu’s rejection of the peace plan?

options.A: It is a formal legal document written for his election campaign.
options.B: It is rhetoric intended to appeal to voters rather than a reflection of his actual policy intentions.
options.C: It is a secret code used by his political party to communicate with the US.
options.D: It is a set of strict rules he plans to implement if he wins the election.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境下，「campaign language」指的是政治人物為了贏得選民支持而說的話，未必代表其真實的政策立場或長遠計畫。美國官員將其視為針對選舉的言論，顯示他們認為這是一種政治表演。選項 A 錯誤，因為這不是正式文件；選項 C 與 D 則曲解了該詞彙在政治分析中的常見含義。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the current state of the Gaza peace process?

options.A: The US and Israel have officially ended their alliance due to disagreements over the Gaza war.
options.B: Hamas has successfully manipulated the peace plan to create a rift between Israel and the US.
options.C: Netanyahu is struggling to balance international pressure for a peace plan with the domestic political demands of his coalition before the upcoming election.
options.D: The peace plan has already failed completely, and there is no hope for further negotiations between the parties involved.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章的核心在於描述 Netanyahu 如何在美國提出的和平計畫與國內極右翼勢力的反對之間尋求平衡，並強調選舉考量對其決策的影響。選項 A 錯誤，因為美以關係依然存在；選項 B 並非文章重點；選項 D 過於武斷，因為文章第六段明確提到雙方仍在溝通，和平進程仍有變數。
